title: 理由与例子的展开
goal: 选择支持论点的相关理由；用具体解释或例子展开理由。

points.label: 选择支持论点的相关理由
用具体解释或例子展开理由

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点及教学材料规格

sources.title: C2 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 依据所给研究文件中的写作语言与连贯性要求安排教学，不陈述考试事实

body.p: 主体段先提出与论点相关的理由，再解释理由为什么成立，最后用具体情境或对比来说明。换个说法重复论点，不算支撑。例子要说明当前的理由，只出现相同的主题词不够。

body.box: Clear task lists can improve group coordination because members can see who is responsible for each action.

body.p: 理由是分工清楚，解释是每项行动都有负责人。例子要写出这种分工怎样避免遗漏，不能只说团队活动很重要。

cards.title: 理由的展开方式
rows: 因果解释
写出从行动到效果的中间过程。
Written roles identify the person responsible for each task, so unfinished work is easier to trace.
因果解释
解释要支持当前的理由，不保证结果。
Early feedback reveals gaps in a plan while students still have time to revise it.
具体情境
写出人物、动作和结果，不需要统计数字。
During a group display, one student checked the labels while another arranged the pictures.
具体情境
实例说明一个可能的过程，不当作普遍规律。
A student notices a missing source during a draft meeting and adds it before submission.
简短对比
比较的两方情况相近，只突出一处差别。
A named task owner can answer questions directly, whereas an unnamed responsibility may remain unclear.
简短对比
比较要说明对当前理由的作用，不只比较喜好。
A draft comment allows revision before submission, while a final comment arrives after that opportunity.

cards.title: 支撑的相关性与充分性
rows: 重复论点
只换了说法，没有原因。补上行为过程。
Weak: Clear roles are useful because roles should be clear. Better: Named roles help members identify who should act next.
例子无关
场景相同，但说明不了效果。改用能说明效果的细节。
Claim: Early feedback permits revision. Unrelated: The feedback session was held in a newly painted room.
论据不足
一个例子只能说明一个人。结论限定在这个人身上。
Limited evidence: One student corrected a plan. Unsupported claim: Every student will produce a perfect project.
例子与理由断开
补一句，说明例子支持理由中的哪一步。
This division of work prevented two members from preparing the same labels for the display.
相关但不够具体
把抽象评价改成可观察的行动和变化。
Weak: The meeting was helpful. Better: A question about costs led the group to revise its budget.

body.box: Claim: A residence should label shared storage shelves. Reason: Labels can reduce confusion about where items belong. Example: After a shelf was marked for cleaning supplies, residents returned brushes there instead of placing them among cooking equipment. This made the next search more direct.

body.p: 理由是减少 confusion。例子写刷子放回了标好的架子，末句说明下次找起来更直接。几句话都围绕标签和查找，不需要写架子的颜色或购买时间。

body.box: Which detail best develops the reason? A resident returns a brush to its marked shelf and can locate it again the next day.

body.p: 这个细节直接说明了归位和查找的关系。补一句 The shelves were bought last year，说明不了标签的作用。

items.stem: Claim: A shared calendar can reduce meeting conflicts. Which reason explains the benefit?
options: A shared calendar is useful because it is a helpful tool for arranging meetings.
Members can compare proposed times with commitments already recorded.
The shared calendar also shows the room in which each meeting will be held.
Members will never miss a meeting once the calendar has been shared.
items.why: compare proposed times with commitments already recorded 说明了日历怎样避免时间冲突，即第二项。第一项只是换个说法重复论点。

items.stem: Reason: Checklists can prevent missing steps. Which example directly develops it?
options: The committee chose a clear font so that the checklist was easy to read.
The committee printed copies of its checklist for every volunteer on the event day.
A volunteer checked the list and noticed that the keys were still uncollected.
A volunteer told the committee that checklists are important for successful events.
items.why: noticed that the keys were still uncollected 展示了清单帮志愿者发现漏掉的步骤，直接对应 missing steps，即第三项。

items.stem: One learner used a glossary successfully. Which conclusion stays within the evidence?
options: A glossary helped this learner understand unfamiliar terms in this task.
A glossary guarantees complete understanding for everyone in every task.
No learner needs any further explanation once a glossary has been provided.
Every glossary is more useful than every other learning resource.
items.why: One learner 只是一个个案，只能说明这个学习者在这项任务中受益，即第一项。第二项把个案扩大到了所有人。

items.stem: Claim: A short rehearsal helps speakers check timing. Which reason supports it?
options: Speakers prefer rehearsal rooms with comfortable chairs and large windows.
A rehearsal is helpful because practicing speeches is a useful activity.
The speech and its rehearsal usually take place in the same lecture building.
A timed practice reveals sections that take longer than the allotted time.
items.why: reveals sections that take longer than the allotted time 说明排练怎样帮助发现超时的部分，即第四项。

groups.text: A student is preparing a presentation with a strict time limit. During a timed practice, the introduction takes much longer than expected. The student shortens that section and leaves more time for the main example. This experience supports rehearsal as a way to check the length of different sections.

items.stem: Complete the explanation linking practice to the stated benefit.
items.why: reveals 说明计时练习让各部分的长度显现出来。conceals 意思相反。

items.stem: Choose from explanation / repetition / location: The sentence about discovering an overlong introduction is an ___ of how rehearsal helps.
items.why: 发现引言超时，说明了排练怎样帮助修改，所以是 explanation。

groups.text: A gardening group keeps seed packets in a shared cabinet. Several packets look alike, and members have sometimes chosen the wrong packet before planting. A writer argues that the group should add clear labels naming the contents. The proposed benefit is easier identification, not a change in the cabinet’s appearance.

items.stem: Which reason most directly supports labeling these seed packets?
options: Clear labels help gardeners distinguish packets that look alike before planting.
Labels would give the shared cabinet a neater and brighter appearance for members.
Labeling seed packets is a good practice because good organization is always important.
Larger cabinets would stop members from choosing the wrong packet before planting.
items.why: Several packets look alike 和 have sometimes chosen the wrong packet 说明问题在于难以辨别，第一项正对这一点。第二项讲外观，材料已说明好处不在外观。

items.stem: Which example best develops that reason?
options: A gardener repaints the shared cabinet so that it looks neater before spring planting.
A gardener checks a label and selects basil instead of a similar packet of mint.
A gardener says again that labeled packets are much easier to identify and organize.
A gardener buys a larger cabinet before deciding which labels to print for the packets.
items.why: checks a label and selects basil instead of a similar packet of mint 具体展示了标签怎样帮人选对种子袋，即第二项。第三项只是重复论点。

items.stem: Complete the causal explanation, keeping the labels as the source of information.
items.why: make the contents of each packet clear 解释了标签怎样避免误选。hide 意思相反，与论点不符。

items.stem: Choose from relevant / unrelated / conclusive: An example of selecting the correct packet after reading its label is ___ support for this reason.
items.why: 例子展示了读标签、选对种子袋的过程，是相关的支撑。一个例子不足以成为定论，所以不填 conclusive。

groups.text: A committee plans to discuss a small budget at its next meeting. The writer supports sending the agenda in advance so members can bring relevant information. For example, a member who knows the topic can prepare cost estimates. Without that notice, the same member may need to request the figures after the discussion.

items.stem: Which sentence explains the benefit of announcing the agenda in advance?
options: Advance agendas improve meetings because improved meetings are useful for members.
The agenda is sent by email with the committee’s usual logo at the top of the page.
Members can prepare relevant information before the topics are discussed together.
All members will agree on the budget whenever they receive an agenda before a meeting.
items.why: so members can bring relevant information 说明提前发议程能让成员先准备资料，即第三项。第四项推出全体一致，材料没有依据。

items.stem: Which contrast best illustrates preparation rather than mere attendance?
options: One meeting was held on a weekday evening, while another was held on a Saturday.
One meeting included experienced members, while the other included only new committee members.
One meeting used printed agendas while another used a different paper color.
A prepared member brings cost estimates; an unprepared member requests them later.
items.why: can prepare cost estimates 和 request the figures after the discussion 形成对比，区别在于是否提前准备了资料，即第四项。

items.stem: Complete the explanation of the budget example.
items.why: gives members a chance to prepare 说明提前发议程给了成员准备的机会，与材料的理由一致。

items.stem: Choose from comparison / repetition / guarantee: Contrasting prepared estimates with a later request for them is a ___.
items.why: 两种准备情况放在一起比较，是对比。材料没有保证任何结果，所以不填 guarantee。
